This '''gaderffii''' may have once belonged to [[Raito]], a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] who was said to have [[Death/Legends|slain]] a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. His tribe died out sometime around the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith Wars]], and his gaffi stick came into the possession of another tribe's [[Storyteller]], who may have given it to [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].

==Behind the scenes==
Raito's Gaderffii is only available to Revan if he gives a [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|krayt dragon pearl]] to the [[Sand People chieftain]] of the [[Sand People Enclave]], in order to be allowed to see their Storyteller. Once that is done, Revan then must slay the Storyteller in order to acquire it.
